title: How Proxy & Upgrade Patterns Works
mermaid:
flowchart TD
    U["User / msg.sender"] -->|call| P["Proxy (on-chain identity)"]
    subgraph PROXY["Proxy: owns storage + value"]
        SLOTS["State storage slots"]
        ADMIN["Admin slot (EIP-1967)"]
        IMPL["Implementation slot"]
    end
    P -->|delegatecall| L["Implementation / logic code"]
    L -->|"runs against proxy storage"| SLOTS
    L -->|"address(this) = Proxy"| P
    GOV["Proxy admin / governance"] -->|upgradeTo new logic| IMPL
    IMPL -.->|points to| L
    NOTE["Constructor never runs vs proxy"] -.-> INIT["initialize() sets state once"]
    P --> INIT

title: Attack Vector
mermaid:
flowchart TD
    A["Attacker"] --> CHOOSE{"Find broken assumption"}
    subgraph V1["Storage collision"]
        C1["Admin in slot 0/1"] --> C2["Collides with _initialized"]
        C2 --> C3["Re-run initialize()"]
        C3 --> C4["Seize governance (Audius)"]
    end
    subgraph V2["Unsafe upgrade"]
        U1["Base adds new variable"] --> U2["No __gap / no ERC-7201"]
        U2 --> U3["Child slots shift down"]
        U3 --> U4["Silent state corruption"]
    end
    subgraph V3["Live implementation"]
        I1["_disableInitializers missing"] --> I2["Call initialize() on logic"]
        I2 --> I3["Attacker becomes owner"]
        I3 --> I4["delegatecall to SELFDESTRUCT"]
        I4 --> I5["Implementation bricked"]
    end
    CHOOSE --> V1
    CHOOSE --> V2
    CHOOSE --> V3
    C4 --> WIN["Funds or control stolen"]
    U4 --> WIN
    I5 --> WIN

title: Defense Pattern
mermaid:
flowchart TD
    START["Harden upgradeable contract"] --> G1
    subgraph LAYOUT["1. Storage discipline"]
        G1["Use EIP-1967 keccak slots"] --> G2["Append-only layout"]
        G2 --> G3["Add ERC-7201 namespaces or __gap"]
    end
    subgraph INIT["2. Safe initialization"]
        H1["Atomic deploy + initialize"] --> H2["initializer modifier (single-shot)"]
        H2 --> H3["Constructor calls _disableInitializers()"]
    end
    subgraph CTX["3. Respect proxy context"]
        K1["No constructor/immutable state"] --> K2["Avoid msg.value in loops"]
        K2 --> K3["Test logic behind a proxy"]
    end
    G3 --> VERIFY{"oz-upgrades validation passes?"}
    H3 --> VERIFY
    K3 --> VERIFY
    VERIFY -->|yes| SAFE["Safe upgrade"]
    VERIFY -->|no| START
